IPL Trade: Pandya to Punjab Kings, Arshdeep Singh to Mumbai Indians

In a significant player trade ahead of the IPL 2027 season, Hardik Pandya has moved to Punjab Kings for ₹18 crore, while Arshdeep Singh is set to join Mumbai Indians. Pandya's father revealed details about the trade, and reports suggest his place in MI was doubtful. The coverage also speculates on Rohit Sharma's potential return as MI captain.
